extensions.title: Strict-parser unknown-field policy and a reserved extension namespace
extensions.answer: Forward-compat rule: the current plugin-host surface freezes six top-level keys (name, version, description, author, license, keywords). Any additive field a newer producer wants to ship MUST use the reserved `x-` prefix. A compatibility linter refuses a non-prefixed additive field so a strict client that rejects unknown keys cannot be broken by a newer manifest.

policy.rule: bare unknown -> reject; same key under x- -> accept; linter blocks emission of bare additive keys
policy.frozen_derivation: Copied from tools/plugin/client_loader.py CLIENT_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS (the estate client's parse surface on this worktree). Not derived from .claude-plugin/plugin.schema.json properties; the schema canary not_a_client_key is intentionally absent from this frozen list so a reviewer can tell client-match from schema-match.
